title: blachia andamanica
intro: Blachia andamanica, commonly known as the Andaman blackwood tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Theaceae. It is native to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in India. The health benefits of Blachia andamanica include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
